mentions.name: game-pick
mentions.description: A platform where groups of gamers share their game libraries with each other and suggest and vote on games for game nights. A group finder feature is planned that will let users publicly search for others to play with; currently the focus is on existing groups.
mentions.audience: Groups of gamers coordinating game nights, both existing groups and (planned) players looking for others to play with
mentions.source_excerpt: Still a small plattform for groups of gamers to share their library with each other and suggest and vote on games for a game night.

evidence.value: Still a small plattform for groups of gamers to share their library with each other and suggest and vote on games for a game night.
evidence.author: thunfischtoast

mentions.author: thunfischtoast

mentions.name: game-pick.eu
mentions.description: A voting-based website that helps groups of friends decide which games to play together. It shows which games are in each friend's library to reveal who would still have to buy a game, with planned features for finding new friends to play with.
mentions.audience: friends deciding together which games to play
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on https://game-pick.eu , a website for friends to easily decide on games to play together. It is voting-based and can show who has which game in their library to see who would yet have to buy it.

evidence.value: I've been working on https://game-pick.eu , a website for friends to easily decide on games to play together. It is voting-based and can show who has which game in their library to see who would yet have to buy it.
